propositions: Completion verifier incorrectly banks met=false at search exhaustion, conflating absence-of-evidence with evidence-of-absence and producing false FAIL verdicts.

Evidence outcomes must distinguish three states: met (criterion satisfied), refuted (criterion disproven), and insufficient (search exhausted without determination) via optional evidence_sufficient:false marker.

The marker is framework-owned, set only by bounded fallback at exhaustion; model tools remain bool-only; harvest preserves prior markers on markerless overwrites; genuine refutation (bare met=false) replaces it.

Verdicts carrying the marker report insufficient evidence + remediation (re-verify, cite untagged evidence) rather than unmet criteria; close gate stays fail-closed but message distinguishes exhaustion from refutation.
Schema, validation, rendering, and sidecar payload all pass the marker; merge_finalizer_with_bank re-stamps every record from its bank entry to keep marker truth authoritative.
Audit ticket page discriminated PASS/FAIL by shape; adding criteria to FAIL payload broke shape proxy; fix keys on verdict field to render failure findings honestly regardless of payload shape.
